```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
creating variables:

```{r}
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- "true"
treated_2 <- "false"

n_before1 <- "5415"
n_before2 <- "8123"

n_after1 <- "1432"
n_after2 <- "7543"
```

```{r}
cell_id_vec <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
print(cell_id_vec)
treated_vec <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
print(treated_vec)
n_before_vec <- c(n_before1, n_before2)
print(n_before_vec)
n_after_vec <- c(n_after1, n_after2)
print(n_after_vec)

```
```{r}
# for example
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
my_only_bird <- all_my_pets[4]
print(my_only_bird)
```


```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_id_vec,
  treated = treated_vec,
  num_cells_before = n_before_vec,
  num_cells_after = n_after_vec
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
